dict.string: Nuo shows your calendars, works out when you're free and lets your bots read, create and edit your events, iCloud included, when you ask them. You choose what they can do in Settings › Bot Access.
To send a photo to a bot.
Face ID unlocks Nuo and confirms sensitive actions (devices, finances, commands).

To answer your bots when you ask them about your fitness: activity, cardio, sleep, workouts and weight. Nuo reads Health only when a request comes in, keeps nothing and sends nothing to the gateway beyond the answer. You choose the data shared, and you turn off access in Settings › Bot Access.
Nuo connects to your gateway on the local network.
With “Always”, your bots get your location even when Nuo is closed, for example for directions or the weather here. Nuo only reads it when a request comes in, never continuously.
For location reminders, and to answer your bots when you ask them where you are, the weather or directions from here. Nuo doesn't track your location: it only reads it when a request comes in.
Nuo listens to your voice so you can talk with your bots.
To send a photo to a bot.
Your voice is transcribed on the iPhone.
